name: Rald Schwarz
source:
Massage Style: Deep Tissue
Likes: Massages, masseurs at Full Service Spa
Dislikes: Office duties, family tradition, and routine

(Kickstarter)
A calm and composed personality is usually seen from him. He is the main boss of Schwarz Bank and is usually seen working. He actually lives a double life as a masseur in Full Service Spa to get away from the tedium of work. He was never known to be a mean boss and is very supportive of his coworkers but he barely interacts with them.

The current owner and CEO of Schwarz Bank. Unlike most bosses, he seems to take a hands on approach and converses with the employees of the company. While this gives him a good reputation among his coworkers, he is also extremely busy, so people rarely even get to know him outside of work.

While being a workaholic at the bank, he finds time to relax with his double life as a masseur at Full Service Spa. While he may be a kind and supportive boss, he has reservations about his life. Will Tomoki be the one to help him overcome it?

(Facebook)
Calm and composed personality is what can be seen from him. He is the most mature masseur in Full Service Spa and reflects his experience on a professional and serious performance. The way he lives as a masseur is proof of a life of freedom that he wished for.

He's a director of Schwarz Bank in Morningwood Branch. As on night time, he works at Full Service Spa. Nobody recognized him because he dressed differently than his regular routine.
